handf.name: ClearPair H & F
handf.subtitle: Hear H/F. Feel the difference.
handf.shortDescription: Hear and practise easily confused H/F sounds in English and Mandarin.
handf.focus: English h/f and Mandarin h/f, with a separate final f/v lesson. Compare lip-teeth friction with breath or back-of-mouth friction, using hat/fat and Mandarin word pairs.

landr.name: ClearPair L & R
landr.subtitle: English L/R, one clear pair
landr.shortDescription: Hear and practise easily confused English L/R sounds, from words to sentences.
landr.focus: English l/r at the start, in clusters and in word-final contexts. Explore tongue contact for L and alternative comfortable tongue shapes for R with pairs such as light/right.

english.name: ClearPair English
english.subtitle: Vowels, TH & tricky contrasts
english.shortDescription: Practise easily confused English vowels, TH sounds and final consonants.
english.focus: English vowel quality, TH contrasts and consonants that change meaning. Compare sheep/ship, bed/bad, full/fool and other contrasts. Accent-dependent distinctions are explained rather than treated as universal errors.

chinese.name: ClearPair Mandarin
chinese.subtitle: Initials, finals & tones
chinese.shortDescription: Practise Mandarin sounds that are easy to confuse: initials, finals and tones.
chinese.focus: Mandarin z/c/s, zh/ch/sh and j/q/x, aspiration, u/ü, nasal finals and tones. Read characters with Pinyin and learn the position or airflow difference, not just a spelling rule.

korean.name: ClearPair Korean
korean.subtitle: Hangul & confusing sounds
korean.shortDescription: Explore easily confused Hangul letters and Korean sound contrasts.
korean.focus: Hangul shapes, plain/tense/aspirated sound families and Korean sound contrasts. Visual recall and optional device-voice listening are separate activities; modern pronunciation variation is acknowledged.

arabic.name: ClearPair Arabic Letters
arabic.subtitle: Dots, joins & sound families
arabic.shortDescription: Tell confusing Arabic letters apart through dots, joins and sound families.
arabic.focus: Arabic letter dots, joining forms and sound families. Visual letter recall is the default; optional listening depends on an installed Arabic voice and is not a specialist recitation model.

japanese.name: ClearPair Japanese
japanese.subtitle: Kana, furigana & tricky sounds
japanese.shortDescription: Remember confusing kana and practise Japanese vowel length and consonant holds.
japanese.focus: Confusing hiragana and katakana, a basic kana map, contextual furigana, vowel length, small kana and consonant holds. Modern stroke animations are attributed to KanjiVG; source-backed kana origins are separate from memory cues. Same-sound script pairs use visual recall, not an impossible sound distinction test.

cantonese.name: ClearPair Cantonese
cantonese.subtitle: Jyutping & tricky contrasts
cantonese.shortDescription: Explore Cantonese tones and confusing sounds with Jyutping and pair practice.
cantonese.focus: Cantonese tones 1/3, 2/5 and 4/6, aa/a, nasal finals, aspiration and unreleased stops. Traditional characters and Jyutping stay Cantonese regardless of the interface language. Initial n/l variation is an ungraded exploration, not a wrong-accent test.
